//: Global dependency blocklist substitution policies. Data table for the readPackage hook in .pnpmfile.mjs. Companion to the overrides block in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which owns the removal cases. See docs/dependency-blocklist.md for the policy reference and the throw/silent/remove decision rule.
//keys: Each non-comment key is an npm package name; keys beginning with // are comments (npm names cannot start with /) and are ignored by the hook. Each policy is { action, reason, allowed? }.
//action: throw = substitute with @monochromatic-dev/pnpm-override-stub-throwing (loud, informative error at the import site). silent = substitute with @monochromatic-dev/pnpm-override-stub-silent (Proxy whose reads/calls/new return the stub; in checks return false). Removal is not an action here; add "name": "-" to the overrides block in pnpm-workspace.yaml instead.
//reason: reason is surfaced one-line in the install-time warning; cite the replacement, migration ticket, or rationale.
//allowed: allowed is an optional array of consumer package names that keep resolving to the real dependency.

caniuse-lite.reason: 3MB+ browser support DB; only the real browserslist package may load it for resolved build targets

convert-source-map.reason: abandoned; modern bundlers (rolldown, oxc, esbuild) handle source maps natively

cookie-signature.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; use node:crypto.createHmac for signed cookies

destroy.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; stream.destroy() is native since Node 8

etag.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; compute via node:crypto.createHash inline

exa-js.reason: Exa AI search SDK deprecated in favor of linkup.so

extglob.reason: abandoned micromatch ancestor; use picomatch (already in graph)

for-in.reason: trivial; use Object.entries / Object.keys with functional iteration

forwarded.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; parse Forwarded header inline

fresh.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; compare conditional-request headers inline

fs.realpath.reason: polyfill for Node<6 fs.realpath bugs; native realpath stable on every supported runtime

js-yaml.reason: unused YAML source; workspace YAML uses the `yaml` package. Its only transitive consumer was cosmiconfig (stylelint, removed 2026-10-04), whose lazy loadYaml was never reached. See docs/troubleshooting/dependencies.md.

methods.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; HTTP methods are RFC 7231 constants

proxy-addr.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; use h3 request helpers

regenerator-runtime.reason: Babel async/generator polyfill; obsolete on Node 22+ and Bun, async/await is native

repeat-element.reason: trivial; use Array.from({ length: n }, () => x) or Array(n).fill(x)

sax.reason: abandoned XML parser; use fast-xml-parser (catalog entry, used by feedsmith)

set-blocking.reason: abandoned yargs<16 internal; native process.stdout writes are sufficient

source-map-resolve.reason: abandoned; modern bundlers handle source map resolution natively

statuses.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; HTTP statuses are RFC 7231 constants

toidentifier.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; trivial identifier-case conversion inline

unpipe.reason: Node stream polyfill; stream.unpipe() native on every supported runtime

vary.reason: abandoned express 4.x util; set Vary header directly
